timing_limitation: One successful inference per configuration; no independent timing per postfilter threshold

recommendation_policy.primary: Largest threshold >=0.35 retaining >=90% of exact reference matches at0.35, >=80% per discipline, all rare type groups with baseline1to4; no increase of draft irrelevant census candidates
recommendation_policy.rare_type_groups: suggested reference types with 1..4 exact matched spans at0.35 within the model
recommendation_policy.secondary: Compare absolute draft reference matching, candidate load, draft noise and measured NER cost; report Pareto limitations, no true optimality claim

qwen_batch_policy.context: full immutable abstract in each batch
qwen_batch_policy.deduplication: document_id,start,end only; retain all hint alternatives; no semantic merging
